lifedates.why: data-02. DELETE deathYear 2024: he is living. Bernama's feature of 25/06/2025 reports him alive at 90, which is after the claimed 2024 death. en.wiki (revised 2026-08-21) has "(born 9 April 1935) is a Malaysian novelist and poet", and LoC authority n81071698 has the open heading "A. Samad Said (Abdul Samad Said), 1935-". The 2024 probably comes from his wife Salmi Manja, who died on 26 December 2023 (both wikis). "living: true" is there so the null is not read as "death year unknown". The activeRange end 2024 was probably copied from the false death year. It is still valid (≤ 2026), so I left it, because I found no dated publication after 2024 to extend it with. CHECKER: in the schema, `living` is an annotation, not a field. The repo's Zod author schema is .strict() and deathYear is optional, not nullable. Apply this as "delete the deathYear key". There is no portrait entry, so the living-face rule does not come into play. ms.wiki (revised 2026-09-22) still reads "(lahir 1935)".
